detaileddescription.para: Use the XAPM_IXR_* constants defined in xaxipmon_hw.h to create the bit-mask to enable interrupts.

parameterdescription.para: Mask to enable. Bit positions of 1 enable the corresponding interrupt. Bit positions of 0 keep the previous setting. This mask is formed by the bitwise OR of the XAPM_IXR__* bits defined in xaxipmon_hw.h.

parameterdescription.para: Write ID to be written in ID register.

simplesect.para: If ID filtering for write is 32 bits wide (for Zynq MP APM), WriteID is written to XAPM_ID_OFFSET. If it is 16 bits wide, the lower 16 bits of WriteID are written to XAPM_ID_OFFSET.

briefdescription.para: Sets the Read ID in the ID register.

parameterdescription.para: Read ID to be written in ID register.

simplesect.para: If ID filtering for read is 32 bits wide (for Zynq MP APM), ReadId is written to XAPM_RID_OFFSET. If it is 16 bits wide, the lower 16 bits of ReadId are written to XAPM_ID_OFFSET.

briefdescription.para: Returns the Write ID from the ID register.

simplesect.para: WriteId is the required Write ID in ID register. If ID filtering for write is 32 bits wide (for Zynq MP APM), the 32-bit XAPM_ID_OFFSET contents are returned. If it is 16 bits wide, the lower 16 bits of the XAPM_ID_OFFSET register are returned.

detaileddescription.para: Runs a self-test on the driver/device.

The test
Resets the device,
Writes a value into the Range Registers of Incrementer 0 and reads it back for comparison.
Resets the device again.

listitem.para:
XST_SUCCESS if the value read from the Range Register of Incrementer 0 is the same as the value written.
XST_FAILURE Otherwise.

simplesect.para: This is a destructive test in that resets of the device are performed. Refer to the device specification for the device status after the reset operation.
